ignoreValues.reason: Documents ATC's existing .text-metal heading gradient from src/index.css:114, which ships on the live site; a brand guide must reproduce the real treatment

Scanner assumes a #ffffff ground and does not resolve the CSS variables; the rendered body computes to rgb(5,5,5) (verified in scripts/brand-pdf.mjs output) and every token measures AA or better against it: faint 5.16:1, muted 6.30:1, gold-500 8.31:1, gold 10.70:1, gold-lite 15.05:1

No body copy is uppercase here. Every uppercase run is a heading (.d-hero/.d-h2/.d-h3, Anton uppercase is ATC's mandated display treatment) or a short label (.eyebrow, .panel h4, caption, thead th, .rule h5, .tag, .stat dd, .colophon dt); longest string is the 22-char heading 'The facts of the league', which is the labels-and-headings case the rule exempts
